messages:
Priya: Quick thread  we need to standardize the "edge protocol" between adapter and runtime for hosted/dedicated/private handoffs. Today every adapter variant rolls its own fields and we leak semantics.
Ben: Agreed. Seen subtle bugs when private runtimes ignore unknown fields and drop snapshot_version, causing silent restores to fail.
Clara: Proposal: formalize a tiny versioned wire spec: EdgeProto v1 => fields: session_id, snapshot_handle, snapshot_meta(version, ttl_ms), capabilities(list). Runtime must return accept_versions and applied_snapshot boolean.
Sam: Love it. Add an explicit "no-snapshot" safe path so adapters can signal intent and avoid retries when capability absent.
Priya: Also need error taxonomy: client-visible (degraded), operational (audit-only), and fatal (reject request). Right now unwrap errors surface unpredictably.
Ben: Operationally we should enforce a 300ms deadline on snapshot apply inside the adapter; if exceeded emit metric edge.snapshot.apply_timeout and continue cold-start.
Clara: Security note: snapshot_handle must always be an opaque envelope and include key_id and nonce metadata. Runtime should return only a hashed audit token on success.
Sam: Backcompat: adapters must include a supported_versions header. Control plane can translate v0->v1 for older runtimes but with conservative semantics (no restore).
InfraBot: Created card ARCH-1401: "edgeproto-v1-spec-and-handshake".
Priya: Next steps: Clara draft spec doc with proto examples and error codes; Ben add adapter conformance tests; Sam update runtime shim to respond to accept_versions. 15m sync tomorrow?
Ben: I'll take tests.
Clara: Drafting now.
Sam: Sync works for me.
Priya: Thanks all.
